A flowchart (Figure 39) was created alongside the test matrix, which begins with EPRI conducting AHRI Standard 210/240 A and H1 tests [106] to ensure consistency and repeatability with ORNL’s test results and Rheem’s manufacturer specifications. Once ORNL and Rheem confirmed the repeatability, EPRI conducted the exploratory tests (U2C, U3H, CR1, CR2, HR1, HR2). The team considered three recharge cases: (i) “typical” temperature, (ii) “least favorable” temperature, and (iii) “highly favorable” temperature for both cooling and heating modes. The test matrix also considers once-through and on/off cycling for both discharging and recharging cases. All cases are chosen to emulate possible operating conditions that may occur during the field test. Table 17 and Table 18 show the proposed test matrix in heating and cooling modes, respectively.
